title: IconFlow living archive
note: Identity-exploration directions authored with IconFlow. 'gated' passed the complete draft-local target gate; 'study' directions were drawn, rendered, and compared but not promoted. None of this is a claim of trademark clearance.

rounds.label: Proof machines
rounds.lede: Ten measurement, press, and proofing objects: the first attempt to draw proof at the last sixteen pixels.

rounds.label: Living care
rounds.lede: A living noun first, a caring action second, and IconFlow rigor hidden in the reduction quality.

rounds.label: Expanded living
rounds.lede: Makers, collectors, guides, shelters, and structural hearts; one behaviour changes the outer silhouette.

rounds.label: Hidden brand
rounds.lede: The animal's real anatomy performs the product truth: a repeated master, a continuous route, a held proof.

rounds.label: Orchard & garden
rounds.lede: Fruits and vegetables whose crowns, peels, pods, and seams carry one family from one source.

rounds.label: Canopy cargo
rounds.lede: One approved leaf canopy, seven different payloads, and the question of what the cargo says about craft.

rounds.label: Organic neko
rounds.lede: A cat, a tomato, and a leaf drawn as one gesture; motion from anatomy, never from cords.

entries.name: Proof Caliper
entries.story: A side-view caliper encloses one coral specimen between unequal jaws. Its stepped beam end is the native-pixel signature.

entries.name: Pantograph
entries.story: One mechanical linkage scales a master pivot toward a detached coral output.

entries.name: Printers Chase
entries.story: A heavy type chase contains one offset coral forme and an unmistakable handle.

entries.name: Arbor Press
entries.story: A compact bench press holds a coral die above a stepped platen. The noun is a machine, not an abstract pipeline.

entries.name: Pixel Shuttle
entries.story: One broad loom shuttle carries a square coral bobbin; one thread becomes many stable surfaces.

entries.name: Master Key
entries.story: A square-bow key ends in deliberately unequal pixel teeth.

entries.name: Proof Wisp
entries.story: An invented warm-paper creature has one square coral eye and an integrated two-step tail. It is deliberately not a robot, known animal, or letter.

entries.name: Caliper Crab
entries.story: A compact crab holds one coral specimen between measuring claws.

entries.name: Split Beetle
entries.story: Unequal elytra expose one square coral inspection chamber; the shell reads before its internal detail.

entries.name: Stencil Fan
entries.story: One folding stencil opens into three platform plates around a coral pivot.

entries.name: Kelp Cradle
entries.story: A supine sea otter cups one coral heart-pebble; paddle tail and long floating body own the horizontal silhouette.

entries.name: Scale Embrace
entries.story: A pangolin tail closes into a sheltering coil; broad stained panes replace tiny scales.

entries.name: Acorn Peek
entries.story: A dormouse ear and tail break through an acorn cup; the shelter is the main noun and the animal supplies the affection.

entries.name: Borrowed Home
entries.story: A hermit crab's spiral shell contains a structural heart aperture while one oversized claw offers the way forward.

entries.name: Coral Beak
entries.story: An upright puffin offers care through its enormous faceted bill; the beak remains the species lock when color disappears.

entries.name: Frill Offering
entries.story: An axolotl's external gills become six fat crown leaves, not fragile filaments.

entries.name: Bill Return
entries.story: A swimming platypus brings one coral river stone home; spatula bill and paddle tail form the noun before the object.

entries.name: Leaf Tent
entries.story: One small white bat sleeps beneath a deliberately nicked shelter leaf; the architecture is made by care.

entries.name: Glass Belly
entries.story: A glass frog clings with four broad toe pads while one coral anatomical heart remains optional above native size.

entries.name: Heart Nest
entries.story: A heart is not a badge but the nest itself, woven around one warm egg and opened by one asymmetrical rim.

entries.name: Trail Companion
entries.story: A colorful side-view dog continues Trail Tail's gait language; its lifted tail creates a heart-like resting counter with the back.

entries.name: Hoopoe Gift
entries.story: A fan-crested hoopoe leans toward a nest opening; crest and bill create an unmistakable heraldic profile.

entries.name: Seahorse Creche
entries.story: A male seahorse's brood pouch and gripping tail make care anatomical; three glass-like regions add color.

entries.name: Wombat Home
entries.story: A blunt square-backed wombat carries a living sod roof home; the turf stays botanical so it cannot become a UI tile.

entries.name: Heartwing Moth
entries.story: An asymmetrical moth closes two broad wings into one heart-shaped night companion; the body cleft prevents a generic Valentine.

entries.name: Heart Curl Fox
entries.story: A sleeping fox wraps one enormous tail around a teal heart-leaf; the heart is protected by the pose rather than worn as a badge.

entries.name: Patch Cat
entries.story: A curled cat holds one repair patch between its paws; ears, tail, and sleeping posture remain the identity before facial detail.

entries.name: Lop Heart
entries.story: A lop rabbit's dropped ear and chest shelter one broad heart-shaped listening space; the ear changes the silhouette decisively.

entries.name: Frill Friend
entries.story: An axolotl whose external gills become six fat crown leaves; the strongest original-character and illustration-family potential of the round.

entries.name: Heart Curl Fox
entries.story: A sleeping fox wraps one enormous tail around a teal heart-leaf; redrawn, then set aside because the fox named a fox brand before IconFlow.

entries.name: Mender Cat
entries.story: A curled cat holds one repair patch between its paws; the warmest direct story of caring for and repairing the source.

entries.name: Heartwing Moth
entries.story: Two broad moth wings close into one heart-shaped night companion; redrawn, then set aside because it named a heart before a moth.

entries.name: Acorn Mouse
entries.story: A dormouse ear and tail break through an acorn cup, redrawn so the cup and the animal read as one silhouette.

entries.name: Hoopoe Gift
entries.story: A fan-crested hoopoe leans toward a nest opening; the crest and bill create an unmistakable silhouette.

entries.name: Otter Embrace
entries.story: A supine sea otter cups one coral heart-pebble; redrawn with a broader paddle tail and a single held stone.

entries.name: Trail Prism
entries.story: Trail Tail's continuous walking-dog route gains three hard broad color bands while retaining its lifted tail, gait, and clasp.

entries.name: Koi Heart
entries.story: Koi Return's side-view fish and upstream opening remain intact while one heart-shaped pectoral fin becomes a broad internal pane.

entries.name: Grain Sleeve
entries.story: A caddisfly larva leans from its tapered case of three broad found panes; the head step prevents a generic seed silhouette.

entries.name: Heart Harbor
entries.story: A heart's lower lobe opens into a deep shelter bay with one nested seed-shaped counter, not a pasted secondary badge.

entries.name: Heart Sprout
entries.story: An irregular heart-shaped seed splits into two unequal cotyledons and one large sprout that changes the top silhouette.

entries.name: Token Avenue
entries.story: A lowered bowerbird arranges three blue tokens inside one broad avenue bracket; curation is the caring action.

entries.name: Vessel Wasp
entries.story: A potter wasp becomes the living shoulder of its handmade vessel; insect and pot share one asymmetrical outline.

entries.name: Leaf Sail
entries.story: A leafcutter ant carries an oversized, visibly bitten leaf; the cut scallop and stepped foot keep the noun from becoming a generic leaf.

entries.name: Loop Weaver
entries.story: A weaver bird tightens a hanging nest whose long entrance tube changes the pear silhouette.

entries.name: Lantern Tail
entries.story: A firefly's own abdomen becomes a flat-bottomed guiding lamp with one broad crescent cut, never a bulb or glow effect.

entries.name: Curator Crab
entries.story: A decorator crab's back is an irregular three-piece skyline of found forms; the collection is part of its body.

entries.name: Sand Bloom
entries.story: A pufferfish tends an asymmetrical six-lobed sand nest; one reduced lobe prevents flower/gear symmetry.

entries.name: Fin Fold
entries.story: A manta folds one wing into a protected heart-like counter; cephalic horns and the rolled corner prevent a paper-plane read.

entries.name: Pane Pulse
entries.story: A cuttlefish's passing color wave becomes three broad bands inside a scalloped fin skirt.

entries.name: Petal Haypile
entries.story: The temporary IconFlow product mark since 2026-08-14: a low-eared pika returns to its hay store carrying three oversized petals.

entries.name: Grass Globe
entries.story: A harvest mouse finishes a woven ball nest while its tail becomes the cradle hook below the sphere.

entries.name: Kakapo Nightfruit
entries.story: A ground parrot carries one fruit as a breast pane; hook bill and scalloped back replace a generic facial disk.

entries.name: Numbat Courier
entries.story: A long-snouted numbat trots with one nested cradle pane and a broad bottlebrush tail.

entries.name: Honey Siphon
entries.story: An inverted honey possum fuses its long snout to one banksia cone; hanging posture is the silhouette lock.

entries.name: Lyrebird Lectern
entries.story: Two thick non-meeting tail ribbons rise behind a grounded bird wedge; copied song becomes the many-from-one metaphor.

entries.name: Jacana Raft
entries.story: A jacana shelters a chick inside one wing bulge while three pad scallops replace fragile toes.

entries.name: Kea Unmake
entries.story: A kea's long bill reduces a pine cone to three broad belly teeth; curiosity and craft replace an applied tool.

entries.name: Archer Crown
entries.story: An archerfish's water jet is a single thick spike fused to the mouth, with no reticle or detached droplet.

entries.name: Deep Canopy
entries.story: An ear-finned deep-sea octopus makes a heart-like shelter above one egg pane; a three-scallop skirt prevents elephant/ghost readings.

entries.name: Velvet Hammock
entries.story: A velvet worm's body and three feet hold one broad heart-like hammock void; uncommon anatomy creates new mascot territory.

entries.name: Mandarin Sail
entries.story: A mandarin drake's tall scapular sail and breast fold into one colorful accompanying form.

entries.name: Capybara Ferry
entries.story: A square-muzzled swimming capybara carries one fused passenger bump above a protected saddle notch.

entries.name: Fairy Scoop
entries.story: A pink fairy armadillo's shell folds into a protective scoop; triangular head and square rear plate prevent a pill/bug read.

entries.name: Tailor Leaf
entries.story: A tailorbird pulls two broad leaf edges into one shelter; the beak notch and edge-open stitch bays carry craft without thin thread.

entries.name: Patch Heart
entries.story: Three broad panes make one asymmetrical heart whose missing corner is repaired by a single coral dovetail.

entries.name: Case Mason
entries.story: Caddisfly case from one repeated tile.

entries.name: Shoebill Proof
entries.story: A bill cleft acting as occupied proof clasp.

entries.name: Tapir Ford
entries.story: Species-true target-state saddle plus sensory proof.

entries.name: Mud Wicket
entries.story: Hornbill bill occupying a verified nest slit.

entries.name: Shell Walker
entries.story: Octopus carrying one house through two target states.

entries.name: Chamber Heir
entries.story: Nautilus rooms as faithful descendants.

entries.name: Tun Survivor
entries.story: Tardigrade identity surviving the 16px state.

entries.name: Knot Haul
entries.story: One hagfish body remaining continuous through a knot.

entries.name: String Midwife
entries.story: Toad carrying a fused loop until release.

entries.name: Coin Plug
entries.story: Spider abdomen as the proof door.

entries.name: Husk Witness
entries.story: One life leaving a source-shaped proof shell.

entries.name: Leaf Ferry
entries.story: One bitten source leaf carried into a larger garden.

entries.name: Scale Unfurl
entries.story: One pangolin scale repeated down a living route.

entries.name: Otter Proof
entries.story: A loved, reused stone as the off-axis proof clasp.

entries.name: Beak Ledger
entries.story: One bill holding a family of faithful copies.

entries.name: Cerata Shawl
entries.story: One identity taking target-state color through anatomy.

entries.name: Eyedrift Fluke
entries.story: The same fish surviving radical composition change.

entries.name: Nest Crescent
entries.story: One continuous secretion becoming a shelter.

entries.name: Gharial Clasp
entries.story: Real interlocking bite as proof geometry.

entries.name: Dew Circuit
entries.story: One capillary path flows tail to mouth.

entries.name: Star Ledger
entries.story: One ray master changes count but remains a mole.

entries.name: Glass Pulse
entries.story: A real internal heart, dispensable at favicon scale.

entries.name: Oven Keep
entries.story: A bird that lives inside the bake-off proof.

entries.name: Ribbon Drift
entries.story: One living ribbon changing orientation without splice.

entries.name: Loop Rule
entries.story: A living 16px measuring practice.

entries.name: Kiln Keeper
entries.story: Original companion carefully carrying a verified tile.

entries.name: Wax Heart Press
entries.story: Structural heart grip, one master impression to many.

entries.name: Fiddle Fin
entries.story: An organic F rhythm that still reads bird-and-fern first.

entries.name: Strawberry Stitch
entries.story: A side-leaning strawberry whose oversized leaf crown closes one diagonal growing seam; avoids stock upright heart silhouette.

entries.name: Lotus Route
entries.story: Oblique lotus-root segment with three large chambers and one sprouting side joint; not a circular perforated slice.

entries.name: Chili Current
entries.story: A broad curled chili whose calyx and tip create one continuous directional route; curve must remain produce, not swoosh.

entries.name: Dragon Crown
entries.story: Dragon fruit with five broad living fins and one large paper flesh opening; colorful silhouette first, seeds disposable.

entries.name: Mangosteen Keeper
entries.story: Squat mangosteen with a four-lobed calyx canopy and one protected inner segment; crown changes the circle.

entries.name: Rambutan Ray
entries.story: Oval rambutan with six broad asymmetric hairs and one off-axis proof hair; no texture fuzz.

entries.name: Fig Harbor
entries.story: Cut fig as a teardrop whose broad interior cavity shelters one seed-shaped source; cavity is structural, not a heart badge.

entries.name: Citrus Peelway
entries.story: A whole citrus whose peel leaves one continuous curling route and one open segment; tail breaks the circle.

entries.name: Banana Cradle
entries.story: A short thick banana crescent cradles one fused seed pod; not a generic moon or smile.

entries.name: Starfruit Step
entries.story: Side-view starfruit with five blunt longitudinal ribs and one displaced end slice; the stepped edge owns the noun.

entries.name: Persimmon Cap
entries.story: Squat persimmon with one oversized asymmetric calyx cape and a deep bottom cleft.

entries.name: Pineapple Proof
entries.story: Compact pineapple with a three-leaf crown and only three broad diagonal proof cells, never a grid.

entries.name: Watermelon Ferry
entries.story: Thick rind wedge with a bitten prow and two large nested seeds moving along one curved chamber.

entries.name: Papaya Canoe
entries.story: Long half-papaya, one asymmetric hooked stem, and three broad seed chambers contained by the canoe.

entries.name: Pomegranate Family
entries.story: Crowned fruit with one edge-open crack revealing three fused chambers; parent silhouette stays whole.

entries.name: Chayote Fold
entries.story: A chayote pear with a single deep side fold continuing into the stem, one shape changing orientation.

entries.name: Pea Pod Parade
entries.story: One open pod protects three large related peas along a continuous seam; no detached dot or icon-grid reading.

entries.name: Garlic Family
entries.story: One bulb grows three differently sized cloves under a tilted stem and scalloped root; literal one-source family.

entries.name: Radish Route
entries.story: Round-tapered radish with two uneven leaves and one long coral root curling through an off-axis gate.

entries.name: Artichoke Nest
entries.story: Broad layered artichoke whose two lower bracts create a protected heart-like opening without drawing a heart.

entries.name: Okra Crown
entries.story: Long ridged okra pod with one star-shaped crown visible as an edge-open end, not a detached slice.

entries.name: Beet Thread
entries.story: Beet body with three leaf shoulders and one continuous root-thread returning into a side notch.

entries.name: Eggplant Cape
entries.story: Eggplant profile whose calyx becomes a three-point cape and whose body has one large paper belly plane.

entries.name: Pumpkin Clasp
entries.story: Squat pumpkin with three broad lobes and one off-axis hooked stem acting as the proof clasp.

entries.name: Onion Handoff
entries.story: Half onion with only two broad nested growth layers and one layer opening into a side route.

entries.name: Kohlrabi Orbit
entries.story: Strange bulb with three outward stems and a single swept leaf; silhouette unlike a generic turnip.

entries.name: Bok Choy Bloom
entries.story: Three thick stems merge into one root while two dark leaves open as an unequal canopy.

entries.name: Corn Quilt
entries.story: One compact cob with three oversized irregular kernels and a husk fold; family without a grid.

entries.name: Tomato Chute
entries.story: A plump tomato hangs under the leaf, with one broad square edge bay cut into the fruit. The bay is an integrated 16 px proof cue rather than a tiny icon-within-icon.

entries.name: Orange Peel Drop
entries.story: A whole orange hangs under the canopy while one broad peel leaves the side as a continuous route.

entries.name: Mango Lift
entries.story: An asymmetric mango is carried by its real leaf shoulder; the off-axis body supplies the memorable silhouette.

entries.name: Blueberry Crown
entries.story: One large berry uses an oversized five-point calyx as its silhouette trait.

entries.name: Strawberry Descent
entries.story: A pointed strawberry with a broad crown becomes the payload, with only two oversized seed cuts.

entries.name: Watermelon Gondola
entries.story: A watermelon wedge becomes the gondola under the leaf canopy; rind and two broad seeds preserve the fruit noun while the whole scene reads as a ferry.

entries.name: Neko Glide
entries.story: A compact cat hangs below the canopy; ears own the noun and a single curled tail carries the motion.

entries.name: Tomato Proof Chute
entries.story: A plump tomato hangs under the leaf canopy with one broad square edge bay cut into the fruit: an integrated 16px proof cue, not an icon inside an icon.

entries.name: Watermelon Gondola

entries.name: Neko Parachute
entries.story: A compact cat hangs below the canopy; ears own the noun and a single curled tail carries the motion.

entries.name: Leaf Cape Chomp
entries.story: A side-view cat carries a real tomato while its single oversized calyx cape catches the air. No cords.

entries.name: Calyx Curl
entries.story: A curled cat closes around a tomato; its tail widens into the sheltering leaf above the bite.

entries.name: Tomato Cove
entries.story: A tomato's edge opening becomes the place where a small cat profile meets the fruit, with the calyx carrying lift.

entries.name: Tailwind Chomp
entries.story: Promoted locally from the organic-neko round.

entries.name: Neko In The Fruit
entries.story: A tomato opens like a warm living chamber and reveals the cat who made the bite.

entries.name: Chomp Orbit
entries.story: Cat, fruit, and leaf form one circulating gesture; the tail becomes the return path rather than an arrow. The first aesthetic gate is comparison beside Leaf Ferry, Mender Cat.
